cohort: Medicaid enrollees aged 15-44 years with sickle cell disease (SCD) who had a recent delivery hospitalization.
finding: Individuals with sickle cell disease (SCD) experienced a high incidence of both SCD-related morbidities (e.g., vaso-occlusive crisis, acute chest syndrome) and obstetric complications (e.g., preeclampsia/eclampsia, antepartum hemorrhage, preterm delivery) throughout the perinatal period, continuing up to 1 year postpartum.
